20584.ins: Kimono sets travel better than any other costume format - the wrap folds flat, the tie adjusts across sizes, and the magnolia print hides travel creases the way solids cannot. Two pieces in as-pictured colorway, one size for 40-60 kg.
20584.short: Magnolia-print Japanese kimono with matching thong in polyester wrap-cut, one size for 40-60 kg, two pieces as pictured.

20590.ins: Purple patent leather is the rarest colorway in costume construction, and on a witch set it replaces the genre's black-fabric default entirely. The bust range runs narrow at 68-74 cm - the one measurement to check honestly before ordering.
20590.short: Purple mandala witch set in patent leather with hand sleeves and dress, bust 68-74 cm, one size for 40-60 kg.

20596.ins: The wrap-and-belt construction adjusts naturally across the 40-65 kg range - wider at the waist than fitted cuts, which is why this listing claims more range than most kimonos. Open-chest cut per the pictures, with thong included.
20596.short: Japanese open-chest kimono set with belt and thong in polyester, one size for 40-65 kg, wrap-tie costume lingerie as pictured.

20601.ins: Secretary and teacher share the fitted-top-and-straight-skirt skeleton, which is why this set can carry both labels without props - the costume is in the tailoring. One size to 70 kg, two pieces, as-pictured colorway throughout.
20601.short: Secretary teacher costume set with top and skirt in polyester, one size for 40-70 kg, two-piece authority-figure role-play set.

20619.ins: Sheer chiffon at three pieces is bedroom-weight by design - the kitten-maid crossover reads costume at a glance and lingerie at conversation distance. The headwear identifies the kitten, the cut identifies the maid, and the fabric decides where it is worn.
20619.short: Sheer kitten maid outfit with headwear, top and panties in transparent lace chiffon, one size for 40-60 kg, three pieces.

20636.ins: Four pieces including the hat - the accessory most police listings drop - and printed bust and waist ranges to settle the fit question at order time. The tie does the authority work; the skirt keeps it costume-length rather than uniform.
20636.short: Four-piece police uniform set with top, tie, hat and skirt in polyester, bust 70-120 cm, one size for 40-60 kg.

20652.ins: Pink is the softer entry in a maid category dominated by black, and the chiffon one-piece keeps the colorway reading sweet rather than costume-bright. The bracelet arrives with the jumpsuit - two pieces, one motion to wear.
20652.short: Pink chiffon maid one-piece with open-crotch cut and bracelet, two pieces, one size for 40-60 kg, soft colorway costume.

20663.ins: The tie-front top is the fitting mechanism as much as the styling - it adjusts to the wearer by design, which is how one cut serves five sizes. Elastic-waist skirt does the same below, and the spandex share carries the stretch.
20663.short: Stretch lace schoolgirl set with tie-front crop top and elastic pleated skirt, sized S to XXL in polyester-spandex knit.

20664.ins: Coral fleece with a real three-size run - the S/M/L bands are honest weight ranges rather than optimism, which is rare in lounge sets. The dog print sits in the same places across all three colorways, so the choice is purely shade.
20664.short: Coral fleece dog-print lounge set with bandeau and pants in black, white or pink, S to L by weight for 40-70 kg.

20679.ins: Navy is the authentic colorway for the school one-piece reference - the white sibling listing reads more costume, this one reads more source material. Polyester swimsuit construction tolerates water, which most costume versions quietly do not.
20679.short: Navy polyester school one-piece swimsuit in Japanese reference cut, one size for 40-60 kg, campus costume in authentic colorway.
